_about: What the agent is grounded on. Our own summary format (not a Copilot Studio file): the Dataverse and SharePoint sources are added in the Knowledge page, see demo.md. Tested against the shared schema.

dataverse.name: Contoso Inspections data
dataverse.description: Inspections (status, score, summary, follow-up), sites (risk level, last inspected), inspection items (category, severity, passed, notes, resolved on) and inspectors. Use it to answer questions about open work, overdue findings and site history.

sharepoint.name: Inspection checklists
sharepoint.description: Contoso inspection checklists: fire doors, electrical rooms, housekeeping. Use for how-to-inspect questions.
sharepoint.authentication: Authenticate with Microsoft (SharePoint uses the signed-in user's access)
